name: Generate schema for a page
prompt: Add schema markup to our blog article.
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md so Organization/brand fields are accurate
Fetches the live page to extract real author, dates, and content
Detects the correct type(s) and outputs valid JSON-LD in a script tag
Includes all required properties and a validation checklist
Never invents prices, ratings, or dates — flags missing values as needs-input

name: FAQ schema from on-page content
prompt: Generate FAQ schema for this page.
expected_behavior: Builds FAQPage Question/Answer pairs only from FAQs actually on the page
Outputs valid JSON-LD that would pass the Rich Results Test
Notes expected rich result and eligibility caveats
Warns against marking up content not visible on the page

name: Multiple types with @graph
prompt: Our page is an article with breadcrumbs and an embedded video — generate schema.
expected_behavior: Combines Article, BreadcrumbList, and VideoObject in a single @graph block
Reminds the user to validate before deploy

name: Product schema with missing data
prompt: Create Product schema for this item.
expected_behavior: Includes Offer, price, currency, and availability when present
Omits AggregateRating/price if not on the page and lists them as needs-input
Does not hallucinate review counts or ratings
Explains which rich result this enables
